definition: An electronic machine that stores and processes information by following instructions.
definition_xh: Umatshini we-elektroniki ogcina aze acubungule ulwazi ngokulandela imiyalelo.

definition: A set of keys used to type letters, numbers and commands into a computer.
A small hand-held device used to move a pointer on the screen and select things.
The part of a computer or phone that shows text, pictures and video.
The part of a computer that holds information while it is being used.
Where a computer keeps files and programs, even when it is switched off.
A named collection of information, such as a document or photo, stored on a computer.
A container used to group files together on a computer.
The programs and instructions that tell a computer what to do.
The physical parts of a computer that you can touch.
The main software that runs a computer and lets other programs work, such as Windows or Android.
A set of instructions written for a computer to carry out.
Instructions written in a programming language.
A named place in a program that stores a value which can change.
Part of a program that repeats a set of instructions.
A named block of code that does one task and can be used many times.
A step-by-step method for solving a problem.
A mistake in a program that makes it behave incorrectly.
To find and fix mistakes in a program.
A test in a program that is either true or false and decides what happens next.
The worldwide network that connects computers and lets them share information.
A collection of related pages on the internet, found at one address.
A program used to open and view websites, such as Chrome or Firefox.
A secret word or set of characters used to prove who you are when you log in.
To copy a file from the internet onto your device.
To send a file from your device to the internet.
A message sent electronically from one person to another over the internet.
Text or an image you click to go to another page or file.
A group of computers and devices connected so they can share information.
A device that sends information between networks, for example between your home and the internet.
Connected without cables, using radio signals.
The radio connection a phone or device uses to reach a network.
Facts, numbers or other information collected and stored for use.
An organised collection of data that a computer can search and update quickly.
Data arranged in rows and columns.
A copy of files kept somewhere else in case the originals are lost.
A harmful program that spreads between computers and can damage files.
A person who breaks into computer systems without permission.
Keeping your personal information safe from people who should not see it.
A new version of software that fixes problems or adds features.
